summary: The town's everyday life today has the movement machinery but no scenes with any purpose behind them. There are 70 walkers that wander between points of interest (crowdSim choosePoi/arrive), sit, browse, and fall into chats with random emoji (startChat, CHAT pool). There are 22 workers who stand at their posts with a generic emoji and an errand once every ~167 s, 3 dockworkers, a balloon seller, and 8 pets, which are the most characterful thing on screen (petSim goGreet/zoomies/scare). Bystanders only react to anything (crowdLooks, borrowCrowd, the 👀 passers-by) while a story is playing. The 8 core residents are just shopkeeper slots (NPC_POST): at idle they behave exactly like the ramen cook, and 阿德, the ramen cook and 阿珠 even wear the same chef hat. So nothing on screen before the whisper tells the player who these people are, who they talk to, or what is secretly wrong in town, and the whisper is a blind guess. The biggest win is a small authored scheduler for everyday scenes ("vignettes"): no LLM, display-only, and dropped the moment any director script touches an agent. Each core resident's signature scene acts out their role in a story (amplifier, enforcer, crowd-rouser, gossip relay, PR shield) and mimes silent hints of secrets that are true (the stage strut that wobbles, the glance back at the oven, the half-staffed station, the fee grievance). Like Hitman's opportunities, this turns free text into free play: watch, suspect, whisper, see if you were right. The same pool of background scenes that never involve core residents (street-performer crowds, a kid chasing the cat, someone dropping their goods) feeds the director's existing "meanwhile" cutaways, so model latency reads as the town living rather than a loading bar. Almost every hook needed already exists: perform()/actPose, scriptGoto-style walking, the pets' greet/flee code, borrowCrowd's arc layout and the bubble billboard.

proposals.title: Vignette scheduler (src/town/vignettes.ts) with a hard yield to the playback director
proposals.player_experience: Before any whisper, 1–3 small scenes are always playing near wherever the camera looks. A new one starts every ~6–10 s and lasts 10–25 s, never repeating the same scene back to back. During a story they quietly stop near the action and only run far from it.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld storyteller pacing (density, cooldowns, a boredom bonus); The Sims' self-driven townsfolk; Two Point's notifications pulling attention to small dramas
proposals.implementation:
WHAT EXISTS TODAY (line anchors as of 10:59; director.ts and TownScene.tsx are being edited by the lead, so anchor by function name):
- Walkers: spawnCrowd(70) at crowdSim.ts:185-198 feeds choosePoi (98-109), routeTo (111) and arrive (280-315). Activities are enter/sit/browse/play/picnic/tend/wait/linger, with a 45% chance of an emoji from ACTIVITY_BUBBLE (81-84).
- Chats only start from proximity: while walking (400-408, dt*0.08, within 1.6 m) or while idle (479-485). They show a random CHAT emoji (80, startChat 317, chat case 449-469) plus a ±0.25 arm wobble (Crowd.tsx:250,259).
- Workers come from worker() (crowdSim 200-245): 5 stall vendors and the balloon seller (emoji only, 439-442), 9 door-keepers (6 of them core residents), the mayor (228-230), the organizer (231-232), 2 hidden officers and 3 dockworkers. Work mode (420-438) means: face outward, an emoji (👋😊📣✨) every ~20 s, an errand once every ~167 s.
- Pets: petSim DEFS (90-137), goGreet (211-225), scare (427-455), the walked shiba (360-424) and pat (458).
- Reactions that only exist during a story: crowdLooks, borrowCrowd, the 👀 passers-by in the talk case (~493) and the 📱 phones in the article case (~602).
- Missing: any multi-actor scene with a beginning, middle and end; any core-resident personality; any visible relationship; any reaction between townsfolk outside a story.

NEW FILE vignettes.ts:
- VigDef: { key, label (Chinese ticker/meanwhile line), zone, hours?, anchor(), cast: { core?, walkers?, kids?, pet? }, storySafe (no core residents), loud, cooldown, weight, maxDur ≤ 40 s, beats: [{ at, run(v) }] }.
- Runtime state: running[], a per-def cooldown map, a per-agent cooldown map, a list of the last 3 keys, and a window.__vig handle in dev.

CHANGES IN crowdSim.ts:
- Two new Agent fields, `vig: Script | null` and `idle: Act | null`, initialised at 195 and 205.
- New functions vigGoto, vigHold and vigFree. vigFree works like releaseScript (355-362): an agent with a home gets errand=2 and headTo(home); everyone else calls goSomewhere().
- In stepCrowd, right after the script branch (393-396), add `if (a.vig) { stepVig(...); continue; }`. stepVig is stepScript (366-383) except that being stuck for more than 6 s sets vig.failed instead of the scripted teleport (walkStep 519-525).
- YIELD: scriptGoto (333) and scriptHold (345) set `a.vig = null`. The director, and any new session script the lead adds, therefore wins on the same frame. The scheduler ends a vignette as soon as any cast member has a script, has lost its vig, or has gone inside, and calls vigFree on the others.
- Keep vignette agents out of other recruiting: add `&& !o.vig` to the walk-chat check (401) and the idle-chat check (480), and to petSim chooseOwner (353).

HOOKS:
- Call stepVignettes(dt, state) in Crowd.tsx useFrame right after stepCrowd (392), with the same scaled dt. Read the camera from state.controls.target and state.camera.position (MapControls is makeDefault).
- load() and reset() in the director call endAllVignettes(). crowdLooks and borrowCrowd call endVignettesNear(at, r) first, so a real public event always beats an ambient scene.
- While ui.selected === npc, end that resident's vignette and hold them facing the camera (the whisper moment).

POLICY:
- Concurrency: up to 3 in explore/compose/results. During playing/paused, only 1, only storySafe defs, and only with the anchor ≥ 18 m from show.shot.a/b, show.focus and every member of show.thinking. LITE: 1. A `?calm` URL flag: 0.
- Starts: one every 6–10 s in explore, every 12–20 s during a story, with jitter.
- Anchor score: weight × 1/(1 + (d/R)²) with R = camera distance × 0.55. Reject anchors beyond 1.4R (off-screen) or within 10 m of another running vignette.
- Cooldowns: 60–180 s per def, 40 s per agent; never one of the last 3 keys. Add +50% weight to loud/wide defs after 20 s with nothing happening near the camera.
- Cast filter, nearest first as in borrowCrowd 327-330: !script, !vig, !home, !job, !post, visible > 0.9, mode walk or idle, and not in show.extras.
- Use a separate rng(4242) so the crowd's seeded random sequence is untouched.
- Put NPC_POST and the persona table in a new src/town/cast.ts to avoid a director⇄crowdSim circular import.
proposals.risk: Two systems steering one agent: fully handled by the single `a.script` check at the top of stepCrowd plus vig being cleared inside scriptGoto/scriptHold. The honesty risk is an ambient scene inside a story shot; the storySafe flag, the 18 m rule and emoji-only output during playback prevent it. It is display-only and never touches the engine or the log.

proposals.title: Core residents' idle personality: stance, gait, idle acts, their own emoji, readable silhouettes
proposals.player_experience:
From the default camera the 8 people can be told apart by how they stand and walk.
- 老周 strolls slowly with his hands behind his back, scanning the plaza.
- 志明 paces with his hands on his hips.
- 阿珠 stomps around and hollers for customers.
- 小雯 hunches over her phone and walks fast.
- 林市長 stands chin-up and waves at anyone who passes.
- 阿德 waves at everybody.
- 美玲 stands with her hands clasped.
- 美咲 stands hand-on-hip with a cup.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims and RimWorld: traits shown through self-driven animation; Two Point staff idle animations; Dwarf Fortress personality quirks
proposals.implementation:
DATA: a CORE table in src/town/cast.ts, one entry per npc:
- look overrides;
- gait { stride, bounce, armSwing, cadence, sway, lean, tempo };
- stance (a partial Pose);
- idleActs, idleEvery, bubbles;
- greetRate taken from PERSONAS[].talkative (scenario.ts:91-161), so idle behaviour comes from the same numbers the prompt uses.
Apply the looks in the spawnCrowd worker() calls (crowdSim 207-232).

Crowd.tsx Person useFrame:
- multiply legSwing (254) by stride, arm swing (259/261) by armSwing, bob (246) by bounce and tilt (264) by sway;
- add gait.lean while moving;
- add stance when standing still (the base pose, 256-271).

WALKING: multiply the phase step in walkStep (597) by cadence. In stepScript (371), multiply speed by tempo clamped to 0.85–1.2, so the personality survives playback walks.

IDLE ACTS: a new low-priority `a.idle`, stepped like act (392). Person blends `agent.act ?? agent.idle` (272), so director perform() always overrides it and the director's thinking check `!a.act` (~733) is never blocked. In the work branch (420-438), core posts use CORE.bubbles instead of the generic emoji list (434) and pick an idle act every idleEvery seconds. If a walker passes within 4 m and rand < greetRate, the resident turns, waves and shows 👋.

NEW POSES in actPose (156-202; unknown kinds already return {}, so adding them is safe): wave, hawk, wipe, offer, photo, check_phone, write, yell, speech, scan, count, hands_hips, hands_back, pickup, trip, juggle, clap, bow, read.

PER RESIDENT:
- 阿德: belly-out stance, bouncy short steps, wave/wipe/giggle; a rare silent glance back at his door with 😬 (oven hint).
- 美玲: hands clasped, light steps, watering/giggle; 🌷💧🐱.
- 小雯: head down, fast walk (tempo 1.15); check_phone/photo/scan; 📸📝📉.
- 美咲: hand on hip with a cup; wipe/wave/giggle; ☕🍰.
- 老周: hands behind back, slow (tempo 0.9); scan/count; 👀🫡.
- 林市長: chin up, stately (0.85); waves only when someone is watching; read/ponder; 🎤😁.
- 志明: hands on hips, choppy steps (cadence 1.4, tempo 1.2); yell/point/nervous glance at the stage; 📋📣.
- 阿珠: wide stance, stompy; hawk / flipping takoyaki / angry glance at the town hall; 🐙💢.

SILHOUETTE FIXES (audit):
- 阿德, the ramen cook (crowdSim 223) and 阿珠 (209) all wear the same chef hat. Give the ramen cook a headband and 阿珠 a hachimaki.
- The news post gets a shop apron (223). Give 小雯 glasses, a beanie and a satchel instead.
- 老周 is dressed exactly like officer-0/1 (222 vs 237). Give him a peaked cap with a badge and scale 1.08.
- 林市長: a top hat (the 🎩 his name tag already shows) and a sash.
- 志明: a clipboard. 美玲: a sunhat with a flower.
- Core residents get a fixed scale of 1.06–1.1.

CARRY PROPS: keep them in a separate persistent `look.carry`, because the director's phone code overwrites and clears `prop`.
proposals.risk: Tempo changes how long playback walks take (waitFor arrival), so keep the clamp. Stance must sit under the talk/listen acts in close shots, never fight them. Changing the core residents' looks touches no logic.

proposals.title: 志明 hurries the stage crew — and the stage strut wobbles (a mimed hint of a TRUE secret)
proposals.player_experience: 志明 paces in front of the stage barking at two helpers hauling crates. One helper leans on the left-rear post; the post shudders and the banner sways. 志明 sprints over waving his hands, shows 😅, shoos the helper away and goes back to yelling as if nothing happened. A player who saw this can whisper 「舞台好像搖搖晃晃的」 to 老周, and his inspection really finds the loose strut.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman opportunities (observe a routine, spot the weakness); Two Point's visibly broken machines; the owner's micro-goal of a fake rumour accidentally exposing a real problem
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'stage-rush'. Core organizer, explore/results only, hours 15–19.6, cooldown 150 s, camera within 35 m. Anchor: the organizer's home at fromLocal(STAGE, 1.6, d/2 + 0.9) (crowdSim 231).

HELPERS: cast 2 adult walkers. They vigGoto from fromLocal(STAGE, ±3.6, 0.6) to (±2.6, -0.4) carrying crates. The crate mesh is currently mounted only for job agents (Crowd.tsx 374); mount it for everyone and toggle it like the phone (326/282).

BEATS:
1. 志明 paces ±1.5 m along the front of the stage (3 vigGoto legs), plays 'yell' and says 「快一點！八點就要開始了！」.
2. At ~9 s a helper walks to the left-rear post (local x = -w/2 + 0.3, z = -d/2 + 0.2; Props.tsx 287-290) and leans on it.
3. Set stageFx.wobble = 1.5. Stage() gets refs on that post and the banner, and in useFrame sets rotation.z = sin(18t) · 0.08 · e^(−1.5t).
4. The helper plays 'startled'. 志明 runs over at 2.8 m/s, plays 'nervous', says 「沒事沒事！別碰！」 with 😅. The helper shrugs and leaves.

WHY IT IS HONEST: it matches FACTS stage_uninspected (true; its check text names the loose left-rear strut). The line never mentions safety or inspection. Gate the def on FACTS.find(f => f.id === 'stage_uninspected').value.

Ticker line: 「🏮 志明在趕工——舞台好像晃了一下？」
proposals.risk: If it is too obvious, every player says the same thing; the cooldown and the camera-distance gate limit that. The wobble only ever plays on the post the engine says is loose.

proposals.title: Make ambient life legible and safe: distance-scaled bubbles, grey ambient line pills, LITE and performance rules
proposals.player_experience: Ambient emoji and two-to-eight-character lines can be read from the default plaza camera, but they never pile up into emoji soup and never look like story dialogue.
proposals.inspired_by: Audit finding (Two Point / RimWorld readability: an icon is only useful if it can be read at gameplay zoom)
proposals.implementation:
ALREADY DONE by the lead: lanterns capped in clock.ts updateGlow (0.25 + lightsOn × 1.5), Bloom softened (threshold 1.25, intensity 0.5) and a fill light added in TownScene SunAndSky.

REMAINING:
(a) Bubble size. The Crowd.tsx bubble Billboard (375-377) is a fixed 0.95 m plane, unlike the pets (Pets.tsx 320-333, which scale by dist/16), so at ~50 m ambient emoji are about 10 px.
- Use the pets' scaling.
- Hide ambient bubbles beyond 45 m.
- Show at most 6 ambient bubbles in view, closest first.
- Hide ambient bubbles within 8 m of any story speaker (Says.tsx owns that space).

(b) Ambient lines. Add a second billboard per Person textured with labelTexture(text, 'rgba(255,255,255,.78)', '#475569') (labels.ts, cached by text). Show it only when show.status is idle or done, never while playing or paused, so story lines stay the only HTML cards. Text may only touch PUBLIC_INFO or nothing topical; true secrets are mimed with emoji only.

(c) LITE mode (DT_MAX 0.25, quality.ts).
- Time beats by accumulated seconds, not frames.
- Arrival tolerance for vignette walks: 0.5 m.
- Chase speed ≤ 2.0 m/s; repath no more often than every 0.5 s (as in stepWalked 413-418).
- Use rand() < dt·k only with k ≤ 1.
- LITE: 1 vignette at a time, no rolling goods or juggling.
- `?calm` turns vignettes off for lab/e2e.mjs and shot-scene.mjs.

(d) Pathfinding. At most 2 findPath calls per frame across all vignettes, maxExpand 20000, short legs (the A* grid is 272×188 cells; a 60000-node search costs milliseconds).

(e) Props. Mount new hand props only on agents that can be cast (8 core + ~20 flagged extras). New small props get castShadow=false.
proposals.risk: Low. The main risk is cluttering the view; the visibility cap and the playback rules handle it.

proposals.title: 阿珠's haggle and fee grumble (vendor = crowd-rouser)
proposals.player_experience: A customer asks for a discount. 阿珠 hollers 「攤位費漲一倍，怎麼便宜！」 with 💢 and glares at the town hall. Sometimes the corn and cotton-candy vendors lean out with 💸, a three-second preview of her power to rally the vendors.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman overheard conversations that advertise opportunities; Two Point's visible complaints; The Sims' want bubbles
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'haggle-takoyaki'. Anchor fromLocal(STALLS[2], 0, 1.5) (the stall's point of interest, layout 444-447). Cast: agentAt('stall-2') plus 1 adult walker within 18 m.

BEATS:
1. The customer vigGoto's the anchor (facing STALLS[2].rot + π, 1.3 m/s).
2. 阿珠 plays 'hawk': 「章魚燒！剛起鍋！」.
3. The customer plays 'talk:ask': 「算便宜一點嘛？」.
4. 阿珠 plays 'talk:complain' for 3 s with the fee line and 💢, turning her head toward the town hall.
5. 60%: the customer giggles with 😋 and leaves carrying a snack. Otherwise: shrug and 😅.
6. 30%: the stall-0 (-4.6, -7.8) and stall-1 (5, -7.6) vendors play 'talk:complain' with 💸. The gather case in the director scripts these same posts, so they hand over automatically.

BACKGROUND VARIANT: for stalls 0/1/3/4 (「玉米三支一百！」), storySafe, so it can fill story time.

Lines only use PUBLIC_INFO (the fee doubled). Ticker line: 「🐙 阿珠又在抱怨攤位費——她一喊，攤商就會聚過來」.
proposals.risk: Low. The vendor scene is never shown during playback; the background variant is.

proposals.title: 阿德's free samples, and he can't stop talking (baker = amplifier)
proposals.player_experience: 阿德 steps out with a tray, kids run over, everyone gets a bite and a 😋. Then he keeps talking; people edge away and he follows them a step, still talking, until they flee with 😅. Once in a while he glances back at his door nervously.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims' chatty trait and social autonomy; Two Point comedy; Hitman 'this person is a leak'
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'samples', hours 15–19. Anchor: the bakery post plus 1.4 m outward (fromLocal as in crowdSim 214-216). Cast: the baker plus 2–3 walkers within 14 m, kids weighted ×3.

BEATS:
1. 阿德 vigGoto's out with a tray, plays 'offer' for 3 s: 「剛出爐！試吃看看！」.
2. The walkers stand in an arc of radius 1.3 facing him (borrowCrowd arc math 331-335), each showing 😋 or ❤️; kids play 'excited'.
3. Chatter loop: 阿德 shows 💬 or 😄 every 1.2 s with 'talk:joke'.
4. The listeners edge 2 m away; 阿德 follows 0.8 m saying 「跟你說喔…」; they leave with 😅.
5. Ending: a 'nervous' turn toward his door with 😬. This is the oven_expired hint: mime only, never words.

Ticker line: 「🥐 阿德在發試吃，話停不下來——消息到他這裡傳最快」 (consistent with his PUBLIC_BIO).
proposals.risk: Weighting kids pulls them off the green's play spots for ~15 s, which is fine. This scene is never shown during playback.

proposals.title: 美咲's gossip circle with a visible ripple (café = relay node)
proposals.player_experience: 美咲 brings a coffee to the terrace table, leans in and whispers. Her two listeners jump (😮), then laugh (😂). One of them walks off and whispers to a stranger, who also goes 😮. You can watch how news leaves the café.
proposals.inspired_by: Plague Inc.'s visible transmission; The Sims' gossip interaction; RimWorld's social texture
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'cafe-gossip', explore only. Anchor CAFE_TABLES[0] or [1] (layout 296). Cast: the café owner plus 2 walkers standing at the table side. Seated agents cannot act, because Person skips acts while sitting (Crowd 272); either let head-only act keys through for sitting agents or cast standing walkers.

BEATS:
1. 美咲 vigGoto's the table carrying a cup and plays 'whisper' for 3 s: 「欸，跟你們說…」.
2. The listeners play 'listen', then 'startled' 0.3 s apart with 😮, then 'giggle' with 😂.
3. Listener 1 vigGoto's the nearest free walker within 10 m and plays 'whisper' for 2 s; that walker goes 😮. Two hops at most, no words after the first line.
4. 40% variant: 美咲 plays 'photo' with ❤️: 「我女兒今晚要上台喔！」 (her PUBLIC_BIO already says this).

Ticker line: 「☕ 美咲在說悄悄話——咖啡廳是鎮上的八卦中心」.
proposals.risk: The ripple could be mistaken for the rumour engine, so it is explore-only, has no topical words, and has no thread lines. It matches what the engine models (美咲 talkative 0.9).

proposals.title: 小雯 runs to every commotion (journalist = amplifier/publisher)
proposals.player_experience: Whenever something loud happens nearby (a performer, a trip, a quarrel), 小雯 hurries over, photographs it 📸, scribbles 📝, and half the time mutters 「這不夠聳動…」 with 📉 and walks back. At her post she photographs passing cats.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld / Dwarf Fortress traits driving visible behaviour; Plague Inc. vectors with different multipliers
proposals.implementation:
TRIGGER: in explore, when a def with loud: true starts within 30 m of SPOTS.news (18.6, -21.2) and she is free. That radius covers the east plaza, stall-2 and the stage.

BEATS:
1. She vigGoto's to 2.5 m from v.at at 2.6 m/s with her hurry gait.
2. 'photo' (phone held out, new act) with two 📸, then 'write' for 2 s with 📝.
3. 50%: 「這不夠聳動…」 + 'shrug' + 📉 (the blog_failing hint as an emoji), then she returns to her post.

IDLE VERSION: any pet within 6 m of her post gets 📸.

She never joins story-time vignettes. Ticker line: 「📰 小雯跑去看熱鬧了——什麼事到她手上都可能變新聞」.
proposals.risk: She leaves her post often, so her click target moves; CoreMarker already follows the agent. Depends on loud defs existing (performer, trip, bicker, patrol).

proposals.title: 'Meanwhile' cutaways during model waits show running vignettes
proposals.player_experience: While Gemma thinks, the camera glances at something actually happening: 「同一時間，廣場上有人在變戲法，圍了一圈人…（志明還在想）」 instead of a dozing cat or 「鎮民在閒聊別的事」.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld's storyteller fills dead air; Two Point notifications
proposals.implementation:
1. In the director tick's stall branch, call requestVignette({ storySafe: true, awayFrom: [show.focus, ...show.thinking], minDist: 18, preferWide: true }) once waited > 6. That way a scene is already mid-action when the existing waited > 9 cut fires (meanwhile set at ~723).
2. meanwhileSpot (298) lists running storySafe vignettes first, with def.label, keeping pets and chats as fallbacks.
3. Leave the vignette running when the camera cuts back.
4. GameUI already frames the cutaway as 「同一時間，…（X還在想）」, clearly side action.
5. The meanwhile shot is medium at dist 22, so only defs readable at 22 m are eligible.
proposals.risk: A vignette spawning beside a thinking resident; the 18 m rule against focus and thinking agents prevents it. Fully honest: it never claims anything about the rumour.

proposals.title: 老周's patrol and the kid who won't stop running (police = enforcer/alarmist)
proposals.player_experience: 老周 does slow, hands-behind-back rounds of the plaza, pausing to scan. He tells off a running kid 「廣場上別用跑的！」. The kid shrugs and bolts the moment he turns away (😜), and 老周 facepalms. Back at the station he counts on his fingers and sighs.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman patrol routes; Untitled Goose Game mischief against a routine; RimWorld traits (careful, anxious)
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'patrol', explore only, cooldown 120 s.

ROUTE: police post → LANTERN_POLES[0] (-10.6, -9.6) → in front of the balloon seller (2.4, -8.1) → in front of stall-2 → in front of the stage → home. Tempo 0.85, hands_back stance. At each stop: vigHold, 'scan' for 2 s, 30% 👀.

KID ENCOUNTER: if a kid walker comes within 4 m, the kid holds; 老周 plays 'talk:warn' for 2.5 s; the kid shrugs; when 老周's heading turns away, the kid vigGoto's off at 2.0 m/s with 😜; 老周 plays 'facepalm'.

AT HOME: 'count' (finger taps) for 2 s with 😓. police_half is his secret, so this is mime only, no line.

When the patrol passes a running haggle or stage-rush, he stops 2 s with 👀. That cross-over is deliberate texture.

Ticker line: 「🚓 老周在巡邏——他寧可多做也不要出事」.
proposals.risk: The patrol crosses other vignettes' anchors; the 10 m spacing applies at start time only, and cross-overs are allowed on purpose.

proposals.title: 林市長 rehearses his speech on the town-hall steps (mayor = PR/defence)
proposals.player_experience: On the steps the mayor rehearses grandly (「各位鄉親父老…」), forgets his lines, facepalms, and checks a card. Whenever someone walks past he switches on a beaming wave (😁), then drops it the moment they are gone. Grey pigeons land; he calmly feeds them.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims' vanity behaviours; Hitman target routines; Two Point comedy
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'speech', from clock.hour 17. Anchor: his home on the steps, fromLocal(hall, 2.2, d/2 + 2.4) (crowdSim 229).

BEATS:
1. 'speech' for 3 s with 🎤 and 「各位鄉親父老…」.
2. 'ponder' for 1.5 s.
3. 'speech': 「今年的燈籠節…呃…」.
4. 'facepalm', then 'read' a paper card for 2 s.
5. Any time a walker is within 5 m: an instant 'wave' with 😁 facing them, then 'doubt' once they are past (his image-conscious trait).
6. 25%: 'read' a ledger with a 💸 sigh. budget_overrun is his secret, so mime only.

OPTIONAL PIGEONS: a pool of 3 small grey birds (2 spheres + 2 wing planes each) lands on the steps, and he plays 'offer'. This matches FACT mayor_pigeons = false, which makes the 「市長怕鴿子」 whisper visibly absurd.

Ticker line: 「🎩 林市長在練演講——他最在意面子」.
proposals.risk: Keep the pigeons grey and plain so nobody confuses them with the festival's caged white doves. The pigeons add a small render cost; skip them in LITE.

proposals.title: Routine previews, friend visits and the festival countdown (make the schedule and social graph visible)
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman's clockwork routines; The Sims' visible relationships; Two Point and Animal Crossing event countdowns building small expectations toward the 20:00 climax
proposals.implementation:
ROUTINE PREVIEWS: turn ROUTINE (scenario.ts:219-225) into defs 'routine-<who>' that fire when the explore clock.hour crosses 15 + at/60, in explore only. Use the same places through SPOTS (sim/geo.ts) and approach-style positioning. The resident walks to the partner's post; they play 'talk:joke' / 'listen' with 💬 only, no words, for 6–8 s; then walk back.

FRIEND VISITS: from PERSONAS.relations with trust ≥ 0.7 (baker↔florist 0.8, police→café 0.7, mayor↔police 0.8, mayor↔organizer 0.7). Cooldown 240 s, with cup or tray props.

COUNTDOWN:
- Hours 18.3–19.3 (the lightsOn ramp, clock.ts 94): a background lamplighter with a pole walks LANTERN_POLES (layout 288-290) and plays 'reach' at each. Two kids follow in single file, re-targeting the agent ahead every 0.5 s, with 🎉.
- 18:30–19:00: a costumed kid plays 'excited' and 'bow' at the stage front while 美咲 claps from the plaza edge.

TICKER CHIP: 「16:30 阿德送麵包去咖啡廳」.

This is the authored schedule, not model output; the engine's rule that a meeting only matters if someone is carrying something is unchanged.
proposals.risk: The explore clock (starts 16:30 and loops 15–20.5) is not the story clock (seed at 15:20); previews must follow the HUD clock. At the 12× explore speed they become unreadable, which is one more reason to cut 12×.

proposals.title: Street performer draws a crowd (big and readable even from the overview)
proposals.player_experience: A juggler starts up by the fountain or under the big tree; kids run over, an arc of people forms, claps and cheers ripple through, a final trick gets a big ✨, a bow, and everyone drifts off.
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point / The Sims crowd attraction; Dwarf Fortress-style 'something is always happening'
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'performer', storySafe, loud (summons 小雯). Anchor: whichever is nearest the camera among the plaza linger spots (layout 449-451) and the green near BIG_TREE (1.6, 3.8) / the green's play spots (452). Keep it off SPOTS.plaza (-4.2, -9.2) and the stage front.

CAST: the performer is an adult walker in a beanie with 3 juggling balls (a pooled InstancedMesh that follows the hands). The crowd is 4–7 walkers within 22 m (kids ×3, elders ×0.5).

BEATS:
1. The performer re-issues 'juggle' every 2.6 s, with 🤹.
2. The crowd vigGoto's into an arc of radius 2.2–3.0 facing the performer (borrowCrowd math 331-335).
3. Every ~2 s a random member plays 'clap' or 'excited' with 👏 or 🎉.
4. At ~12 s the performer jumps ('excited' ✨) and the whole crowd plays 'excited'.
5. 'bow' with 🙇, then vigFree for everyone.

Ticker / meanwhile line: 「廣場有人在變戲法，圍了一圈人」.
proposals.risk: A large crowd blocks walking lanes; anchor rules and the 18 m distance from any story agent handle this. Juggling balls are off in LITE.

proposals.title: Kid chases the calico cat (pets × kids slapstick)
proposals.player_experience: A kid spots 麻糬 loafing, charges (😆), the cat bolts (🙀). The kid tries twice more and either trips and laughs or gives up. Elders chuckle, and a nearby dog joins the chase.
proposals.inspired_by: Untitled Goose Game chase comedy; RimWorld animals as story agents
proposals.implementation:
TRIGGER: a kid walker within 9 m of a cat in loaf/sit/groom with cooldown 0, within camera range. storySafe.

BEATS:
1. The kid vigGoto's the cat at 1.9 m/s with 'excited' and 😆, repathing every 0.6 s.
2. Within 1.6 m, call a new exported flee(cat, fromX, fromZ), factored out of scare() (petSim 434-453), with 🙀. The kid re-targets up to 3 times.
3. Ending: 50% 'trip' with 😵 then 'giggle'; 50% 'shrug'.
4. Elders within 6 m play 'giggle' with 😂.
5. A dog within 10 m runs at the cat at runSpeed; the existing scare chain does the rest.
6. On 麻糬's street (petSim range -25..-9, -7..11), a free 美玲 plays 'worried' with 🐱 and takes 2 m toward the cat (animal-lover hint).

Meanwhile line: 「有個小孩在追麻糬」.
proposals.risk: The flee target must respect the cat's range (reuse the inRange check). Pet repulsion (walkStep 547-557) keeps the kid about 0.6 m away, which is fine. Speeds stay at or below 2.3 m/s, safe at the LITE step.

proposals.title: '現在鎮上' (happening now) ticker replaces the town statistics
proposals.player_experience: Top-left shows one line about the nearest running scene, for example 「🐙 阿珠又在抱怨攤位費——她一喊，攤商就會聚過來」. Clicking it glides the camera there. The core-resident lines double as a light tutorial on what each person is good for.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld letters and Two Point notifications: the game points you at small dramas; Plague Inc. node descriptions
proposals.implementation:
1. Replace the stats block in TownScene Hud (~209-238: 「N 位鎮民：x 人在走動…」 and the cat/dog counts) with a 250 ms poll of vignettes.running sorted by distance to controls.target, showing def.label.
2. On click, widen camRequest (TownScene 39, currently { view: ViewId | null }) to also accept { x, z, dist }, and reuse the CameraRig 'active' glide.
3. Optional attract mode: after 25 s with no input in explore, glide to the current scene; any pointer or key input cancels it.
4. Hide the ticker while a story is playing (the CaptionBar owns that space then).
proposals.risk: Labels must only state public role functions (PUBLIC_BIO level), never secrets in words. Attract mode may annoy players who are aiming at someone; it cancels on any input.

proposals.title: Someone trips and drops their goods; strangers help
proposals.player_experience: A shopper or dockworker stumbles (😵), oranges roll across the cobbles, two passers-by hurry over to pick them up, there is a bow (🙇) and a 😊. Now and then the balloon seller loses a balloon and a kid watches it float away (😢).
proposals.inspired_by: Two Point slapstick; The Sims' social kindness; Untitled Goose Game dropped objects
proposals.implementation:
CAST: a walker with a bag prop, or a dockworker on its crate leg (job agents, crowdSim 239-246; the def may borrow them and restore the job at the end). storySafe, loud.

BEATS:
1. 'trip' for 1.4 s. New act: lean 0.5, arms flail at -2.4, small lift, step back -0.2.
2. Spawn 4 goods (oranges or fish) from an 8-instance pooled mesh (a new DroppedGoods component next to Crowd). They roll 0.6–1.2 m with damping.
3. 😵, then 🙏.
4. 1–2 walkers within 6 m vigGoto the goods and play 'pickup' for 1.5 s each; the goods vanish.
5. 'bow' with 🙇.

15% VARIANT: at the balloon seller (BALLOON_SELLER 2.4, -9.4), one balloon sphere floats up 8 m and a kid plays 'startled'.
proposals.risk: Goods under people's feet can look buggy. In LITE, place the goods without rolling.

proposals.title: 美玲 and the pigeon cages (the festival doves exist on screen)
proposals.player_experience: Stacked dove cages stand beside the stage. 美玲 brings feed, coos at the birds (🕊️), then stands looking at them a beat too long with 😔. On the way back the calico cat greets her and she crouches to pet it. Kids gather at the cages.
proposals.inspired_by: Hitman's observable details; The Sims' trait animations; Two Point's readable objects
proposals.implementation:
MISSING PROP: FACTS (the scenario's pigeons / pigeons_sick check texts) describe 20 dove cages beside the stage, but Props.tsx has none.
- Add PIGEON_CAGES (~6 instanced wire boxes with healthy white birds) beside the stage in layout.ts, register them in OBSTACLE_OBBS, and the nav grid rebuilds from layout at load.

DEF: hours 16–19.5, explore only.
1. 美玲 carries feed and vigGoto's the cages.
2. 'offer' with 🕊️.
3. 'worried' for 2 s facing the cages with 😔. florist_guilt is her secret, so mime only.
4. On the way back, petSim goGreet (friends 'flower') brings 麻糬 over, and she does the crouch-pet reaction.

storySafe SIDE VARIANT: kids play 'excited' at the cages.

This also gives the engine's go_look scenes at the stage something real to look at.

Ticker line: 「🌷 美玲去看鴿子了，看起來有點心事」.
proposals.risk: Changing the nav grid near the stage changes walkMetres / travelMinutes (geo.ts caches paths) and so the engine's timing. Re-run scripts/check-layout.ts and the engine tests, and keep the cages clear of the stage-front spot.

proposals.title: Neighbours bicker over a bike or a flower pot (small conflict)
proposals.player_experience: Two neighbours by the mart bikes argue: 「腳踏車又擋到我家門口！」 versus 「哪有！」, both stomp, a passer-by snickers, and it ends either in mutual facepalms or a grudging 🤝.
proposals.inspired_by: RimWorld social fights (scaled down to comedy); The Sims' disagreements; Untitled Goose Game petty quarrels
proposals.implementation:
SETUP: def 'bicker', storySafe, loud. Anchor: the mart bikes (StreetProps Bikes 274-291, at fromLocal(mart, -2.6, 3.4)) or a front-yard gate (YARDS front, homes zone). Cast: 2 adults or elders.

BEATS:
1. A plays 'talk:complain' with 😤.
2. B plays 'talk:deny' with 🙄.
3. Both play 'angry' (stomping) for 1.5 s.
4. A passer-by plays 'giggle' with 😂.
5. Ending: 50% both 'facepalm' and leave in opposite directions; 50% 'shrug' with 🤝.

VARIANT at 美玲's pots (Props FlowerPots 302-325): an elder nudges a pot and 美玲 (explore only) politely plays 'talk:ask'.
proposals.risk: Low.

proposals.title: Upgrade the existing chats: topical emoji pairs, animated turns, 3-person groups, bench chats
proposals.player_experience: Background chats look like conversations: one person says 🏮 and the other answers 🎉 with a gesture, a third passer-by sometimes joins to make a little cluster, and elders chat side by side on benches.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims' social animations; RimWorld's social interactions
proposals.implementation:
1. Replace the CHAT pool (crowdSim 80) with reply pairs: [['🏮','🎉'], ['🐙','😋'], ['💸','😤'], ['🌇','😌'], ['🐱','🥰'], ['⚓','🐟']].
2. startChat (317-326) picks a pair; b answers with the second emoji after 0.8 s.
3. In the chat case (449-469), swap the speaker on each bubble: perform(speaker, 'talk:joke', 1.4) and perform(listener, 'listen', 1.4). Today a chat is only an arm wobble (Crowd 250/259).
4. At walk-chat start (400-408), let a walker join an existing pair within 2 m (partner = nearest member, standing in a triangle).
5. When both seats of a bench are taken (BENCHES points of interest, layout 437-443), alternate bubbles while they stay seated.
6. During playback, drop ❗, 😮 and 👀 from ambient pools; those are the director's story-reaction emoji (deliver ❗, talk 👀).
proposals.risk: Negligible CPU (pose math already runs for every Person). Three-way chats must end cleanly when the anchor member leaves; the existing check that the partner is still in chat mode already handles it.

proposals.title: Pets greet each resident in character
proposals.player_experience:
When 麻糬 visits:
- 美玲 crouches to pet her ❤️.
- 阿德 tosses a crumb 🥐.
- 美咲 slips 胖橘 a fish 🐟.
- 小雯 photographs 煤球 📸.
- 老周 gives a stiff salute 🫡.
- 阿珠 tosses the dogs octopus bits 🐙.
- The mayor only smiles at a cat when somebody is watching.
proposals.inspired_by: The Sims and RimWorld: traits shown through small interactions; Untitled Goose Game's animal-human comedy
proposals.implementation:
1. petSim arrive (262-278) currently gives every greeted person a generic 😍😊🥰. Route it through onPetGreet(who, pet) in cast.ts.
2. Core reactions as a low-priority idle act plus a bubble, keyed by post. The pets' friends lists already line up: 麻糬 → flower/bakery, 胖橘 → cafe/mart, 煤球 → books/news, 海苔 → seafood (petSim 90-137).
3. 林市長 reacts only if a walker is within 6 m. 老周 adds a 😊 only after the camera is more than 25 m away. Kids play 'excited'; elders play 'offer'.
4. When the walked shiba passes another dog, both play 'sniff' face to face for 2 s while the owner chats.
proposals.risk: goGreet already skips agents with a script (petSim 212-215), so story residents are never touched.

cut: The explore HUD's town statistics (TownScene Hud ~209-238: 「70 位鎮民：x 人在走動、y 人在聊天…」 and the cat/dog counts). Numbers nobody acts on; replace them with the '現在鎮上' happening-now ticker.

The explore HUD's time scrubber and the 暫停/1×/4×/12× speed buttons. Dev tooling that makes the panel look like a simulator; at 12× every vignette and routine preview is unreadable. Keep a small clock and camera presets only.
The generic door-keeper emoji pool ['👋','😊','📣','✨'] (crowdSim 434). Identical for all 8 core residents and the 9 shopkeepers; replace it with per-resident sets.

❗, 😮 and 👀 in the ambient CHAT pool (crowdSim 80). They are the director's story-reaction emoji (❗ on deliver, 👀 on talk), so during playback a background chat near the action looks like the rumour spreading.

Core residents' random errands (crowdSim 425-432). Once every ~167 s a core resident walks into another shop and disappears for 10–24 s while their click target stays live; replace with authored signature scenes and friend visits.
meanwhileSpot's weak fallbacks as the first choice (「鎮民在閒聊別的事」, 「X 在發呆」, director 298-305). Keep them only as fallbacks behind running vignettes.
Duplicate chef hats: the ramen cook (crowdSim 223) and the stall-2 vendor (209) wear the same hat as 阿德, putting three identical silhouettes on one street.
The journalist's shop apron (the news post inherits the awning-colour apron, crowdSim 223) and 老周's officer-clone uniform (222 vs the officers at 237). Both erase the core silhouette.
Optional: trim the walker count from 70 back to ~56 (Crowd's own default) and spend the budget on purposeful clusters. Fewer aimless walkers crossing the frame read better than more noise.
